name: DiFluid R2 Refractometer
author: Roy Ackerman
description: Local Bluetooth TDS, refractive index, temperature and measurement status for the DiFluid R2 Extract (firmware 2.1.2 or later).

MeasurementTimeoutMs.label: Measurement timeout (milliseconds)
MeasurementTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of a test before reporting a protocol failure to Decaid. Default 45000; integer 15000 to 180000. Idle devices do not time out.
